punctuation.ocr: 203 PRAYERS FOR THE DAY BEFORE NEW MOON . When I consider thy heavens , the work of thy fingers , the moon and the stars which thou hast ordained ; what is man that thou art mindful of him ? andthe son of man that thou visitest him ? For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels , and hast crowned him with glory and honour . Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands ; thou hast put all things under his feet : all sheep and oxen , yea , and the beasts of the field ; the fow ] of the air , and the fish of the sea , and whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas . O Lord , our Lord , how excellent is thy name in all the earth ! Say " It is incumbent on us . " A Mourner says Kaddish .
